purpose: Candidate off-active-module ASL Citizen labels for the negative-challenge non_target_asl_sign type. Selected to be concrete, common, and confidently NOT in the 95-label PopSign-v1 active recognition module (per data/active-module/vocabulary-active-module.snapshot.json). Used as the --label-file input to scripts/probe_asl_citizen_zip_index.py.

generated_by.approach: Manual selection of common ASL signs likely present in ASL Citizen 2700+ vocabulary but not in the 95-active-module. Skips labels that visually or lexically resemble active-module labels (e.g., 'phone' skipped because the active module has 'call_on_phone'; 'plane' skipped because the active module has 'airplane'). Does not download or extract media; only seeds the existing zip-central-directory probe.

selection.rationale: 30 concrete labels (nouns + transit + occupations + weather + body-related) chosen for high prior probability of being in ASL Citizen but not in the 95-active-module. The probe's matching pattern is filename-token (path stem starts with numeric_id-GLOSS.mp4 in uppercase), so the candidate token must match the asl-Citizen file naming convention; the manual selection above mirrors well-known ASL Citizen labels from the dataset's published Vocabulary list.
